reading: The sketch is a Team Members admin page: a page title with subtitle, a blue '+Invite' button, a filter toolbar (search plus two dropdowns and a columns button), a bulk-action bar for selected rows, a data table card listing 10 members with avatars/roles/status/usage, an open status-dropdown menu floating over the table, and a pager at the bottom, plus a run-wide note on page background, typography and text colour.
